SASBDB entry SASDNH7  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDNH7/)

Publication: Structural basis for topological regulation of Tn3 resolvase.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkac733

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDNH7/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
